meta_description: Don W Electrical is a qualified electrician in Nottingham. NICEIC certified, fast response times, and transparent pricing for all domestic and commercial work.
hero_subhead: Faulty electrics? From urgent rewires to minor repairs, we fix problems fast without the premium price tag.
services_subhead: Whether it's a sparking socket, a full house rewire, or new lighting, we handle all domestic and small commercial work with care and precision.

services.title: Emergency Repairs
services.desc: Sparking sockets, burnt-out circuits, or blown fuses? We diagnose and repair electrical faults the same day, any day of the week.

services.title: House Rewires
services.desc: Old, dangerous wiring puts your family at risk. We install modern, safe systems to Building Regulations with a 10-year guarantee.

services.title: Lighting Installation
services.desc: From recessed ceiling lights to feature pendants, we plan, install, and test bespoke lighting schemes that transform your rooms.

services.title: Consumer Unit Upgrades
services.desc: Replace outdated fuse boards with modern RCD-protected consumer units — safer, more reliable, and essential for home insurance compliance.

services.title: Testing & Certification
services.desc: Landlords and new homebuyers: we carry out full electrical inspections and provide EICR certificates for peace of mind.

services.title: Garden & Outdoor Wiring
services.desc: Safe, weatherproof installations for garden lighting, outdoor sockets, and water features — all IP-rated and fully tested.

about_pullquote: I start every job like it's my own home — no shortcuts, no surprises.
about_para_1: Don W Electrical was founded on a simple idea: homeowners deserve an electrician they can trust. With over 15 years on the job in Nottingham, I've built a reputation for honest advice, fast turnarounds, and work that lasts. I'm NICEIC certified and fully insured, which means every installation meets Building Regulations and comes with proper documentation.
about_para_2: Customers come back because they know they won't be overcharged or oversold unnecessary work. I'll always give you a clear explanation of what's wrong and what needs doing before I start. That transparency and reliability have made Don W Electrical the electrician neighbours recommend to neighbours across Nottingham.
reviews_heading: What Nottingham Homeowners Say About Us

reviews.text: Had a problem with a blown circuit and was dreading the cost. Don came out the next morning, found a faulty kettle was causing it, and the fix only took 20 minutes. Honest bloke, fair price, no messing about. Highly recommend.
reviews.author: Michael T.

reviews.text: We needed our old house rewired before we could get insurance. Don sorted it out in under a week, kept the disruption minimal, and his paperwork was spot on. Very professional. We'd use him again for anything.
reviews.author: Emma L.

reviews.text: Called for an emergency — lights kept flickering throughout the house. Don was here within the hour, diagnosed a problem in the consumer unit, and had us back to normal by evening. That's the level of service you want in a crisis.
reviews.author: David P.
